def solve():
    import sys
    mod = 1000000007
    
    def multi(m1, m2, to, sz):
        # compute to = m1 * m2 mod mod
        tmp = [[0]*sz for _ in range(sz)]
        for i in range(sz):
            for j in range(sz):
                s = 0
                for p in range(sz):
                    s = (s + m1[i][p] * m2[p][j]) % mod
                tmp[i][j] = s
        for i in range(sz):
            for j in range(sz):
                to[i][j] = tmp[i][j]
    
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    sz = k + 1
    
    # ans = identity
    ans = [[1 if i==j else 0 for j in range(sz)] for i in range(sz)]
    
    # t[p] for p=0..k-1
    t = []
    for p in range(k):
        mat = [[0]*sz for _ in range(sz)]
        for i in range(sz):
            for j in range(sz):
                if i == j or i == p:
                    mat[i][j] = 1
        t.append(mat)
    
    # build bit (suffix sums)
    bit = []
    temp = n
    while temp > 0:
        bit.append(temp % k)
        temp //= k
    bit.append(0)
    # compute suffix sums in place
    for i in range(len(bit)-2, -1, -1):
        bit[i] += bit[i+1]
    
    # main loop over digits
    for p in range(len(bit)-1):
        # multiply ans by t[i%k] for i from bit[p]-1 down to bit[p+1]
        low = bit[p+1]
        high = bit[p]
        for i in range(high-1, low-1, -1):
            multi(t[i % k], ans, ans, sz)
        
        # pre and suf arrays
        pre = [[[0]*sz for _ in range(sz)] for __ in range(k)]
        suf = [[[0]*sz for _ in range(sz)] for __ in range(k)]
        
        # pre[0] = t[0]
        for i in range(sz):
            for j in range(sz):
                pre[0][i][j] = t[0][i][j]
        for i in range(1, k):
            multi(pre[i-1], t[i], pre[i], sz)
        
        # suf[k-1] = t[k-1]
        for i in range(sz):
            for j in range(sz):
                suf[k-1][i][j] = t[k-1][i][j]
        for i in range(k-2, -1, -1):
            multi(t[i], suf[i+1], suf[i], sz)
        
        # update t
        for i in range(sz):
            for j in range(sz):
                t[0][i][j] = suf[0][i][j]
        for i in range(1, k):
            multi(suf[i], pre[i-1], t[i], sz)
    
    total = sum(ans[i][k] for i in range(sz)) % mod
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
